dossiers.catalyst_stack: On April 26, 2026 Noble added about $565 million of new contract value and later booked bp UKCS, a $136.2 million Brunei Viking campaign on July 10, and a 670-day ConocoPhillips Interceptor P&A fixture on August 7. July 27 results reset the year: Q2 adjusted EPS of $0.01 missed ~$0.18–$0.19 estimates, Brazil ANP suspensions of Noble Faye Kozack and Noble Courage took $43 million out of revenue, and FY2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance was cut to $850–$925 million, with the stock down 9.07% on July 28. Analysts then split, as Citi and Susquehanna cut targets in June–July, Barclays trimmed to $53 but stayed Overweight on July 30, Fearnley upgraded to Buy on July 29, and Citi raised its target to $50 on September 7. Plaintiff firms opened securities investigations around August 10 without filing suit, while September 28 tape tied a 7% bounce in Noble and other offshore drillers to Middle East tensions and higher oil.
dossiers.key_assumption: The July 2026 Brazil/ANP downtime and EBITDA guide cut are a utilization shock rather than a structural loss of Petrobras or Guyana work, so 2027–28 fixtures can refill 2026 white space if oil stays supportive.

dossiers.catalyst_stack: On 2026-06-30 Transocean locked in a license-conditional Equinor package worth over $1 billion across seven rig-years, capping a backlog wave that also included Petrobras extensions, the Vår Energi Barents award, Harbour/Santos fixtures, and the 2026-08-20 ONGC KG2 letter of award. Q2 2026 results on 2026-08-05 printed a $0.03 adjusted EPS beat and $966 million of contract drilling revenue, and Fearnley upgraded the stock to Buy on 2026-08-07 even as Barclays cut its target to $7 on 2026-08-12. Merger-arb improved after Transocean certified DOJ second-request compliance on 2026-08-25 and a 2026-09-21 report that antitrust clearance could come early narrowed the Valaris spread. A 2026-09-25 SDNY dismissal without prejudice of the securities class action removed a near-term legal overhang, while 26% short interest leaves squeeze convexity if backlog conversion and the Valaris path hold.
dossiers.key_assumption: Equinor license conditions are satisfied, the Valaris combination obtains DOJ/HSR clearance without a break or synergy miss, and oil-linked floater demand stays firm enough for the new multi-year backlog to convert to FCF rather than idle time.

dossiers.catalyst_stack: On 2026-09-23 SLB won OQEP’s Bisat-B expansion in Oman to 548,000 bpd of gross fluids plus four years of O&M, and on 2026-09-28 it added four multi-year Aramco integrated well-construction awards after the 2026-06-30 seven-year KOC Ahmadi Innovation Valley contract covering nearly 100 AI and production-optimization projects. Deal-making is the other pillar: SLB agreed on 2026-08-31 to buy Kelvion for about $3.4 billion cash plus $700 million of assumed debt to enter AI data-center cooling, completed the S&P Global geoscience software purchase on 2026-09-01, and signed Tachyus in May, while the 2026-07-14 Liberty Energy alliance and NOC pacts with PETRONAS Suriname, Pertamina, and PDVSA extend digital, subsea, and power reach. Q2 2026 on 2026-07-24 printed $8.972 billion of revenue and $0.55 of adjusted EPS, beating estimates, and on 2026-09-14 UBS raised its target to $75 with a Buy, joining Wolfe and Bernstein Outperform calls. The offset is Q1 2026 on 2026-04-24, when profit fell as the Iran war disrupted Middle East activity—an international exposure that still hangs over the book even after the Q2 rebound.
dossiers.key_assumption: Kelvion closes on the stated cash-and-debt terms without a dilutive equity raise, and Middle East activity does not re-break the way it did in Q1, so the Aramco/Oman/KOC awards and the Q2 beat dominate the Iran-war miss.
